john-hughes.bio: Student of Swami Lakshmanjoo who recorded his lectures; designated by him in 1991, with Denise Hughes, to continue publishing his teachings (Universal Shaiva Fellowship). Editor-in-chief of the Lakshmanjoo Academy and a leader of its study retreats.

swami-ram-kashmir.bio: Kashmiri Śaiva master (1852–1914 per the Lakshmanjoo Academy; Wikipedia gives 1854–1915), initiated by Swami Manakak; he revived study of the Śaiva texts and was the root of Lakshmanjoo’s modern line.

swami-mahtab-kak.bio: Chief disciple of Swami Ram and teacher of Swami Lakshmanjoo (1870–1942).

swami-shankarananda.bio: American-born teacher (b. 1942) in the Nityananda–Muktananda line who teaches meditation, Self-inquiry and Kashmir Śaivism at The Ashram, Mount Eliza (Australia). In 2015 he admitted sexual relationships with members of his ashram community; see the place’s public safety record.

set.note: Initiated into the tradition by Swami Lakshman Joo in 1987 (her own site).
Initiated as a teacher by Rudi on 10 May 1972.

anuttara-trika-kula-varanasi.name: Anuttara Trika Kula: the continuing circle of the late Mark Dyczkowski (Varanasi / online)
anuttara-trika-kula-varanasi.description: The circle and archive of Mark Dyczkowski (1951–2025, died in Varanasi 2 February 2025): his recorded Tantrāloka, Spanda and Śiva Sūtra courses and free lectures, and online Tantrāloka Reading Circles led since 5 April 2026 by his students Arjun Seernels and Brian Campbell.
